editorial:
Imagine you are a professional hitman who just finished a big job. You have eight severed heads in a bag to prove to your boss that the job is done. Now imagine you get to the airport and someone accidentally grabs your bag. That is exactly the nightmare Tommy Spinelli wakes up to in this wild ride. The movie feels like a chaotic vacation gone wrong, mixing dark humor with a frantic race against time. You will find yourself rooting for a criminal simply because his situation is so stressful and ridiculous that you cannot help but laugh.

The pacing is quick, and the acting keeps the story moving even when the plot gets a bit messy. While some of the jokes are a bit dated, the sheer absurdity of the premise makes it a blast. If you love movies where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, you should definitely give this a try. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After a long and stressful chase, Tommy finally gets his bag back. However, the big twist is that he discovers the heads in the bag are not the ones he started with. He realizes he has been tricked and the wrong evidence was delivered. In the end, the chaos catches up to him, and he does not get the happy ending he wanted. He ends up losing everything because of a simple luggage mix-up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and heist-style mishaps.
